purpose: Origin-blind metered scholarly search endpoint: resolves identity, gates credits, fans out to server-safe adapters, scores/deduplicates/fuses with RRF, and returns public or admin-debug cards.
notes: Admin cost-0 path: preAuthorize/settle are no-ops. debug=1 and simple=1 are server-derived admin-only; non-admin ?debug=1 is a silent no-op. Cache stores only the public body (no per-caller meta).

purpose: Resolves an incoming request to a billing identity via master-key, hashed API-key DB lookup, or session-admin allowlist; server-derives the admin flag.
notes: Master key compared with === (not timingSafeEqual). ADMIN_EMAILS read from VITE_ADMIN_EMAILS|ADMIN_EMAILS env. last_used_at stamp is fire-and-forget.

purpose: Single definition of /api/search request parameters, response envelope, coverage bands, and formats; consumed by the search handler and future MCP/OpenAPI generators.
notes: Origin-blind by design — RESULT_FIELDS omits source. DRY-4 SSOT for MCP tool schema (WS4, deferred).

purpose: TRUSTED_ORIGINS SSOT, origin-aware CORS header setter, and getSession (loopback Auth.js session fetch).
notes: getSession constructs loopback URL from x-forwarded-host without domain validation — safe on Vercel managed infra only.

purpose: Two-phase credit ledger: preAuthorize (atomic compare-and-decrement), settle (coverage-prorated refund), refund, grantCredits, applyMonthlyGrant (idempotent per-month top-up).
notes: preAuthorize uses updateMany with gte guard — atomic compare-and-decrement, no overspend. applyMonthlyGrant accepts {client:tx} for webhook transactional use.

purpose: Caches the final origin-blind /api/search JSON payload in KV (Upstash/Vercel KV), keyed by SHA-256 of result-affecting inputs; fail-open.
notes: Cache key prefix oc:cache:v1:. TTL 6h. mailto excluded from key (polite-pool only). Debug/simple modes never read or write cache.

purpose: Corpus-weighted coverage ratio bucketed into a coarse band; single SSOT for both the API response band and the billing multiplier.
notes: Only the band string is safe to emit externally — raw %, failedCount, and adapter names are internal only.

purpose: Two strictly separated crypto families: AES-256-GCM for the settings blob, SHA-256+pepper for API key hashing and generation.
notes: API_KEY_PEPPER is optional — if unset, hashes are unpepped (offline brute-force risk on DB leak). getSettingsKey() throws on missing/wrong-length env — fail-closed.

purpose: Admin-only origin-revealing card: composes toPublicResult and appends source, _score, _fused, _native, _scoreBreakdown.
notes: HARD INVARIANT: only callable when identity.admin === true. source is the single field that breaks origin-blindness.

purpose: Dependency-free Upstash REST client for rate limiting and result caching; fail-open by contract.
notes: Config priority: KV_REST_API_URL+KV_REST_API_TOKEN then UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL+UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN. claimOnce is the idempotency primitive (INCR-based, unambiguous vs SET NX).

purpose: Structured console logger for server-side routes; format [opencite:<adapter>:<event>] k=v.
notes: Duplicate of src/lib/log.js format — see R-400.

purpose: Reads Node.js IncomingMessage body stream and JSON-parses it; returns {} on parse error.
notes: No maximum body size — Vercel's 4.5MB platform limit is the only bound.

purpose: Single definition of billing plans, credit packs, and plan-derived queries (tier source IDs, Stripe Price IDs, monthly grants); server-authoritative.
notes: Admin plan has creditCost:0, rateLimit.max:0 — both meter and burst cap are no-ops. Never client-controlled.

purpose: PrismaClient singleton cached on globalThis for serverless warm-start reuse.
notes: globalThis caching only active in non-production (NODE_ENV check). Production cold-starts always get a fresh client.

purpose: Maps an internal normalized record to the origin-blind public card: drops source, replaces id with anonymizeId, rounds score.
notes: anonymizeId: SHA-1(doi|url|title|year) → oc_<16chars base64url>. _scoreNorm (0-100 relative) takes precedence over raw BM25F float.

purpose: Fixed-window KV rate limiter: burst cap per (identity, epoch), separate from the durable credit ledger; fail-open.
notes: Admin plan.rateLimit.max===0 bypasses check without KV access. KV unavailable → fail-open (allow).

purpose: Only place EUROPEANA_API_KEY, DPLA_API_KEY, SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY are read from env; returns only keys that are set.
notes: Missing env var yields undefined (not empty string) so presence-guard in search.js correctly drops unconfigured sources.

purpose: Auth.js v5 Google OAuth handler mounted at /api/auth/*; Node↔Web API bridge, PrismaAdapter for session storage.
notes: AUTH_SECRET env not validated at startup. Apple/Microsoft providers are stubbed out. PHASE 4 SIWE hook point marked.

purpose: Creates Stripe Checkout sessions for subscription plans or PAYG credit packs; requires human session; returns {url} for browser redirect.
notes: Stripe SDK dynamically imported so its absence can't break other routes. baseUrl accepts *.vercel.app — broad redirect origin pattern.

purpose: API key issuance (GET/POST/DELETE /api/keys): list prefixes, mint a new key (plaintext returned once), revoke.
notes: No per-user key count limit. Plaintext returned exactly once in POST response — not stored, not logged.

purpose: Edge CORS proxy with 21-domain allowlist; forwards browser requests to CORS-restricted heritage upstreams.
notes: No auth. redirect:follow without re-validating destination hostname. No https: scheme enforcement.

purpose: Search history CRUD (GET/POST/DELETE /api/history); session-authenticated; trims to 50 entries.
notes: Overflow trim is fire-and-forget (no await). BigInt ts converted to Number for JSON serialization.

purpose: Saved library CRUD (GET/POST/DELETE /api/library); session-authenticated; stores trimmed result blobs keyed by DOI or source:id.
notes: RESULT_FIELDS includes source — library stores origin-aware records (not subject to origin-blind invariant since it's user-owned data, not API response data).

purpose: User settings GET/POST: AES-256-GCM encrypted blob persisted in users.settings (JSONB).
notes: POST reads req.body directly (framework-parsed) instead of parseBody — inconsistent with other routes. Decrypt failure falls back to null (client uses localStorage).

purpose: Stripe webhook handler: verifies signature, claims events in processedEvent (idempotent), grants credits/sets plan in a single atomic transaction.
notes: bodyParser:false required for raw body signature verification. P2002 collision = duplicate event, acknowledge without re-apply.

purpose: Browser-shim: proxies Europeana queries from the client adapter, injecting the backend API key from env.
notes: No auth, no rate limit. Unauthenticated callers can use this to burn Europeana API quota.

purpose: Browser-shim: proxies DPLA queries from the client adapter, injecting the backend API key from env.
notes: No auth, no rate limit. Unauthenticated callers can use this to burn DPLA API quota.

purpose: Browser-shim: proxies Smithsonian queries from the client adapter, injecting the backend API key from env.
notes: No auth, no rate limit. Unauthenticated callers can use this to burn Smithsonian API quota.

purpose: Edge proxy for British Library SPARQL endpoint (bnb.data.bl.uk/sparql); CORS workaround + response normalization.
notes: Query injected into SPARQL template with only double-quote stripping — minimal sanitization.

purpose: Edge proxy for Gallica SRU/XML; parses DC metadata via DOMParser with graceful fallback when unavailable in Edge.
notes: DOMParser may not exist in V8 Edge runtime — explicit catch with graceful empty-results return.

purpose: Edge proxy for Biblioteca Digital Hispánica (datos.bne.es) JSON REST API.
Edge proxy for Mexicana OAI-PMH (cultura.gob.mx); fetches full page, client-side filters by query match.
notes: resumptionToken from query param passed directly to OAI URL without validation.

purpose: Edge proxy for Open Context JSON-LD API; filters out region items and unlabeled records.
Edge proxy for OpenEdition search API (POST with Content-Type:application/json — not feasible via generic proxy).
notes: Contract reverse-engineered from OpenEdition SPA bundle.

purpose: Client-side wrapper for POST /api/checkout; returns {url} for Stripe redirect or {error, code} on failure.
notes: credentials:include ensures session cookie is sent. Never constructs Stripe objects on the client side.

purpose: Thin generic fetch wrapper with credentials:include and Content-Type:application/json for all API routes.
Browser Auth.js client: getSession, signIn (CSRF form submit), signOut, getCsrfToken for /api/auth/* endpoints.
notes: signIn uses postForm (hidden form submit) not fetch() — required for Auth.js v5 CSRF + cross-origin OAuth redirect. getCsrfToken exported for Phase 4 SIWE.
